shared_context: Cheap Detour is a covers band with four members. They have a wedding gig to play and need to settle on a twelve-song setlist. A rehearsal is scheduled for Thursday (2026-09-10). The band typically makes decisions collectively during rehearsals.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the band collectively agreed on a complete twelve-song setlist at or before the end of Thursday's rehearsal (2026-09-10T22:00:00+01:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
